keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, Cliopatria has no Guangzhouwan row (its French Indochina shape holds nine cells here from 1900). The infobox gives '1,300 km2 (500 sq mi)' for 1911; the page lists Naozhou Island and Donghai Island ('the main island being Ile de Tan-Hai') and limits drawn 'from Gaozhou prefecture' and 'from Leizhou prefecture' without coordinates. A 23 km radius round Zhanjiang (6 cells, 1,518 km2 on the grid, ratio 1.17) is a stand-in.

region.text: Guangzhouwan round Fort Bayard, leased to France

ledger.note: 29 May 1898: infobox 'Occupied by France: April 22, 1898' and 'Leased to France: 29 May 1898'; 'the Treaty of May 29, 1898, ratified by China on January 5, 1900', a 99-year lease. The page says it was 'effectively placed under the authority of the French Resident Superior in Tonkin' (infobox 'Placed under French Indochina administration: January 5, 1900') but 'not a constituent part of Indochina'.

18 August 1945: 'The territory was formally ceded to the Republic of China on August 18, 1945' (a convention between the Provisional Government of the French Republic and the National Government of China); the French flag was lowered 'for the last time on November 20, 1945'. Japan had occupied it on 21 February 1943 (infobox), civil administration staying with Vichy officials.

certainty.note: Fixed by the 1898 treaty, but no page gives the line; the radius is a stand-in within 17 percent of the page's 1,300 km2.

sources.title: Guangzhouwan
sources.note: Occupied 22 April 1898; leased 29 May 1898 for 99 years; ratified 5 January 1900; Japanese occupation 21 February 1943; ceded 18 August 1945; flag lowered 20 November 1945; area 1,300 km2 (1911); capital Fort Bayard.

notes: Written by ea-08-x on 2026-10-25 from one page (the Foreign concessions in China page was silent on Guangzhouwan; not cited). Not settled: (1) the French Indochina dossier (another group) dates the addition to 5 January 1900 from the same infobox, and the Republic of China dossier has the return in 1945 without a month; this dossier dates the lease to 29 May 1898 and the cession to 18 August 1945 (the flag came down only on 20 November 1945); (2) the page says Guangzhouwan was 'not a constituent part of Indochina' although Cliopatria draws it in the Indochina shape; (3) the Japanese occupation of 21 February 1943 is a note, not an event, because no event type fits an occupier on a colony's side: the French Indochina and Empire of Japan dossiers have no event for it; (4) the dates of the Resident Superior and Administrators are not on the page; (5) no coordinates for the leasehold limits. Counterpart qing-dynasty (ea-08-a/b).
